## Captain's intent
Update the web viewer's first-visit tour copy. The welcome message should point to the paper Simplification of Trajectory Streams, and the description should say it simplifies the trajectory while keeping the shape of it. For the epsilon and delta description, mention the complexity of the program as an O-notation quantity related to epsilon, and that the Fréchet distance guarantee is (1+ε)δ. That is good enough. Do not mention match tolerance or grid spacing - those are not accurate. Register the project and ship a PR on a proper PR branch.

2. ε and δ step: remove match-tolerance / grid-spacing wording. State that smaller ε costs more time, with per-point complexity O(ε^{-4} log(1/ε)) for the 2D web case (paper α=4 when d=2), and that Fréchet distance stays within (1+ε)δ. HTML may use ε / δ / Fréchet; MathJax-friendly markup is fine if already used nearby.

   needs-decision/blocked/paused/done/failed states. No step-by-step FYI progress lines;
